ai.audit.revert.conflict: Cannot revert alone: a newer change touched the same elements ({table}). Undo the newer changes first.
ai.audit.revert.done: Change reverted. Newer changes are kept; Undo restores it.
ai.audit.revert.many: Cannot revert alone: too many newer changes to compare. Undo them first.
ai.audit.revert.tip: Newer changes sit on top. Reverts only this change, if nothing newer touched the same elements. One undo step.
ai.audit.revert.unsafe: Cannot revert alone: it would leave broken references. Undo the newer changes first.
ai.audit.undo.covered: Newer changes sit on top. Undo them first, newest first.
ai.audit.undo.gone: Already undone or no longer in the undo history.
